bottomNav.$description: BottomNav's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--bottom-nav-<name>) on the page, a container or one BottomNav, and every BottomNav inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

text.$description: A link's icon and label (4.5:1 on bg).

text-hover.$description: A link under the pointer (not the current one, which keeps its own color).

icon-bg-hover.$description: The pill behind the icon under the pointer (not on the current item, which keeps its own fill).

icon-bg-pressed.$description: The pill behind an item's icon while the item is held down, one step past hover (not on the current item, which keeps its own fill).

text-active.$description: The current page's icon and label (4.5:1 on bg).

icon-bg-active.$description: The pill behind the current page's icon.

focus-ring.$description: The keyboard focus ring, inside the link.

height.$description: The bar's height above the safe-area inset (64px); links fill it, so each is a 64px-tall target.

badge-offset-x.$description: How far from the icon pill's start edge a badge starts: 4px past the middle, so it sits on the icon's top-end corner.

badge-offset-y.$description: How far below the icon pill's top edge a badge sits.

z-index.$description: Its stacking: with a sticky Navbar, under dialogs and toasts.
